patches.problem: The ABSENT-input path accepted any non-empty acquisition response as ACQUIRING without comparing the returned observation's derived age and content age to the sport/kind limit. An empty store could therefore be filled with ancient content and receive the wrong state label.
changes: apply the dual-clock freshness re-gate to ABSENT -> acquired transitions
keep ancient or unknowable acquired observations DEGRADED
allow genuinely current acquired observations to recover only to ACQUIRING, which remains fallback-only and non-actionable until refreeze
derive starter_slots_capped from current-value/action authority so ACQUIRING fallback rows cannot be counted as uncapped

verification.absent_acquisition_pair: PASS — ancient content degrades; genuinely current content recovers
verification.acquiring_cap_coherence: PASS — fallback values, capped count, and action state agree

patches.problem: The mc_engine lineage's convergence gate (3-sigma batch-block check on simulated probabilities) raised ConvergenceError and killed the slate builder with exit 1 (observed: 2.968pp on HOU@NYM, 2.715pp on COL@ATL); the sportsmodel/main lineage had no convergence gate at all, so a simulator measuring its own RNG could emit an actionable probability.
changes: port the batch-block convergence check from lineage/mc_engine_20260830/harness/mc_engine.py (CONVERGENCE_SIGMAS=3.0 on the pooled-Bernoulli se of a block proportion, TRIALS=30000, BLOCKS=10) as harness/mc_convergence.py
register the named tolerance MC_CONVERGENCE_TOL_PP=2.7386pp, derived not tuned: the worst-case (p_pool=0.5) value of the ported per-game threshold 3*sqrt(0.25/3000)*100

bind the gate INTO the forecastable/actionable gate: a CONVERGENCE_FAIL demotes the game to forecast-only (actionable=False, input_value_policy=REGISTERED_FALLBACK_ONLY, verdict and pre-demotion state recorded for audit); the rest of the board still builds — fail-closed, not fail-loud-process-kill
convergence never promotes: a clean verdict leaves a degraded freshness disposition non-actionable
regression tests: synthetic gap above tolerance demotes with audit recorded and the board builds around it; gap below tolerance keeps the normal actionable path

patches.problem: Stale or absent observations could remain described as bettable; MLB historical game logs could be stamped as confirmation of tonight's starter; stale pitcher rates still entered V13 before probability shrinkage.
changes: separate forecastable from actionable; only FRESH + CONFIRMED is action eligible
emit REGISTERED_FALLBACK_ONLY as the value policy for every non-actionable input
require exact normalized full-name identity instead of trusting people[0]
grade an MLB game log POST_HOC_NOT_PREGAME for starter identity
replace stale MLB starter rates with the registered V13 CAP treatment while retaining the old observation for audit
keep content-age and post-acquisition age re-gates fail-closed
